title: enginesave remove --tmp --json
description: 0.9.0 (D55): output of `enginesave remove --repo DIR --tmp --json`. Without --yes (or with --dry-run) nothing is deleted, dry_run is true and result is null. Only snapshots/.tmp-* folders and entries of objects/.tmp are ever deleted; one changed in the last 10 minutes is kept. With --yes the object store is collected afterwards (also when there was nothing to delete).

modified.description: newest modification time inside, ISO-8601 UTC

recent.description: changed in the last 10 minutes (a snapshot's temporary folder also while anything in objects/.tmp did, 0.10.0): may be in use, kept

held_by_store.description: 0.10.0 (D59): only when it is old itself and kept because a file in objects/.tmp changed in the last 10 minutes

freed_bytes.description: the folders' files and the objects collected

gc_skipped.description: why unused objects were not removed

store_busy.description: 0.10.0 (D59): only when temporary snapshot folders were kept because a file in objects/.tmp changed in the last 10 minutes
